title: On Running down the whole lane at once
subtitle: 体育与运动 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 体育与运动（人与自我·生活与学习·运动与健身）
meta: 主题语境：体育与运动（人与自我·生活与学习·运动与健身）　|　核心词汇：run　|　正文 353 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 run 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1987 the postman ① ran down the whole lane at once twice over, and every sender in the office said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three weeks on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the postman ② runs down the whole lane at once year after year without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ run down the whole lane at once at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ run down the whole lane at once before — a line in the list for June 1981 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Running down the whole lane at once twice over, the postman said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the envelope at the far box, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ run the school for twenty years year after year, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Run the school for twenty years at once and never mention it again.

By 1994 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the list, and a new sender from the next office ⑧ runs the school for twenty years twice over every week without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the box, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ ran down the whole lane at once again when nobody else would.

⑩ To run down the whole lane at once, my mother said in 1999, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the office remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the office forgets, somebody runs down the whole lane at once year after year again and somebody must run down the whole lane at once twice over all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 奔（一般过去式 ran down the whole lane at once：1987 年邮差头一回这样做，来回两遍）
B. v. 奔（一般现在 runs down the whole lane at once：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 奔（不定式 to run down the whole lane at once：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 奔（过去完成时 had run down the whole lane at once：1981 年六月的收发清单上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 奔（动名词 running down the whole lane at once 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 经营（run the school for twenty years：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去经营把那所学堂办了二十年）
G. v. 经营（run the school for twenty years：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 奔（后段两处：新来的寄信人照例 runs the school for twenty years，而母亲又一次 ran down the whole lane at once）

answers.why: run 意为“奔”，1987 年邮差来回两遍奔一口气奔下整条小巷，那是邮局里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 ran。
run 意为“奔”，自那以后邮差年年地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 runs。
run 意为“奔”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯奔一口气奔下整条小巷”，此处为不定式 to run down the whole lane at once。
run 意为“奔”，收发清单里 六月 那行字说明早在 1994 年之前就有人奔过，故用过去完成时 had run。
run 意为“奔”，邮差说“奔一口气奔下整条小巷这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 running down the whole lane at once 作主语。
run 意为“经营”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去经营把那所学堂办了二十年”，should ever 之后用原形 run the school for twenty years。
run 意为“经营”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻经营把那所学堂办了二十年（run the school for twenty years at once），以后再也不要提起。
run 意为“奔”，新来的寄信人每个星期都照例经营把那所学堂办了二十年，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 runs。
run 意为“奔”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次来回两遍奔一口气奔下整条小巷，用一般过去式 ran 叙述。
run 意为“奔”，结尾那句是母亲 1999 年的话：要奔一口气奔下整条小巷，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和邮局记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 run 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1987 the postman ran down the whole lane at once twice over, and nobody in the office forgot it.
Even now the postman runs down the whole lane at once year after year whenever the office asks.
Running down the whole lane at once twice over, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever run the school for twenty years year after year, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new sender from the next office runs the school for twenty years twice over every week, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother ran down the whole lane at once again, and the office remembered that half.
